title.zh: Anthropic因坚持Claude安全红线被列为国家安全风险，2比1败诉后申请重审
title.en: Anthropic因坚持Claude安全红线被列为国家安全风险，2比1败诉后申请重审

current_state.zh: Anthropic filed for en banc rehearing in a Washington federal appeals court on October 13 after a 2-1 panel upheld the Pentagon's blacklisting of the company as a national security supply-chain risk over Claude's safety guardrails, a ban Anthropic says has cost it billions in business.
